$comment: Allowed values of TaskType.ColourKey: a named palette of ten, never a free hex value. A null ColourKey means the neutral default. The backend embeds this file (TaskTypeColours) and validates against it; the Angular palette (shared/task-type/task-type-colours.ts) is kept in step by a unit test. Colour is never the only signal: the icon and the name are always shown too.
